calendar.matters:
ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Sep-11-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly for hearing on petition for name change. Milton Katz, Esq. represented the petitioner who was not present in court. Mr. Katz presents to the court a declaration from the petitioner regarding service of OSC. The petitioner states that she is unable to locate the father and the court determines that the father has effectively abandoned the child. Court orders the minor's name change to Anthony Lee Woo. Decree signed in open court.
